$speckit-constitution Create principles focused on code quality,
testing standards, user experience consistency,
and performance requirements
Stack: Node.js + Express (backend), React ^18.3.1, PostgreSQL (database)

Ran mandatory `before_constitution` hook (`speckit.git.initialize`, which no-op'd). Updated `.specify/memory/constitution.md` with concrete principles for code quality, testing, UX consistency, performance budgets, and operability; set Version 1.0.0 with ratification/amend dates 2026-05-23. Synced `.specify/templates/tasks-template.md` to make tests required by default per constitution. Reported optional post-hook `/speckit-git-commit`.
$speckit-specify "Create a specification based on the requirements in scenarios_inventory.md"

Executed mandatory `before_specify` hook (`speckit.git.feature`) which returned `001-scenarios-spec` but indicated git repo detection issues (spec creation proceeded anyway). Read `scenarios_inventory.md` and generated `specs/001-scenarios-spec/spec.md`, `.specify/feature.json`, and `specs/001-scenarios-spec/checklists/requirements.md` with validation passing and no `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers. Reported optional `/speckit-git-commit` hook.
$speckit-plan

Ran setup script `.specify/scripts/bash/setup-plan.sh --json`, created `specs/001-scenarios-spec/plan.md`, and generated planning artifacts under `specs/001-scenarios-spec/`: `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `contracts/api.md`, `quickstart.md`. Updated `AGENTS.md` to reference `specs/001-scenarios-spec/plan.md`. Reported optional `/speckit-git-commit` hooks (before/after plan).
$speckit-tasks

Generated `specs/001-scenarios-spec/tasks.md` with 55 tasks organized by user story (US1/US2/US3), explicit file paths, and `[P]` markers. Reported optional `/speckit-git-commit` hooks (before/after tasks).
$speckit-implement

Executed implementation from `specs/001-scenarios-spec/tasks.md`: scaffolded backend/frontend, Postgres docker-compose, SQL migrations, DB helpers, API routes/middleware, inventory services with audit logging and low-stock alerts, backend tests (integration/unit), frontend admin UI scaffolding + basic tests, and docs updates. Marked all tasks as completed in `specs/001-scenarios-spec/tasks.md`. Then fixed backend TypeScript build config by splitting `tsconfig.build.json` and updating `backend/package.json` build script. Added CORS support and adjusted frontend API client to avoid preflight on GET.
how to start this project

Provided run steps: `docker compose up -d`, then `backend/` install/build/migrate/dev, then `frontend/` install/dev, with default URLs backend `http://localhost:3000/api` and frontend `http://localhost:5173`.
I got error ... TS6059 ... File ... backend/tests/... is not under 'rootDir' ... Found 8 errors.

Explained TS6059 root cause (`rootDir: src` while including `tests/**`). Implemented fix: add `backend/tsconfig.build.json` to compile `src/**` only; update `backend/package.json` build script to `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`; remove `rootDir` from `backend/tsconfig.json`.
I ran "npm run migarate" ... ECONNREFUSED ... connect ECONNREFUSED ::1:5432 ... 127.0.0.1:5432
Explained Postgres was not running on `localhost:5432`. Recommended `docker compose up -d` from repo root, confirm container is up, then `backend/` build + migrate.
I got error { "code": "UNKNOWN", "message": "Failed to fetch" }

Explained browser could not reach API or was blocked by CORS. Implemented CORS support in backend and then refined: frontend `apiClient` no longer sets `Content-Type` on GET; backend CORS config simplified to allow `http://localhost:5173`. Instructed restart backend/frontend.
CORS console errors: blocked by CORS policy ... No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header ... net::ERR_FAILED
Diagnosed as preflight + restrictive CORS. Patched `frontend/src/services/apiClient.ts` to avoid preflight on GET and loosened backend CORS config in `backend/src/api/app.ts`. Provided restart steps.
npm run build ... TS2307: Cannot find module 'cors' or its corresponding type declarations.

Explained `cors` was added to `backend/package.json` but dependencies were not installed yet. Instructed `cd backend && npm install && npm run build`, and suggested `npm ls cors @types/cors` if still failing.
